name: com.atomicviz/diagrams
title: AtomicViz Diagrams
description: Interactive diagrams you can collapse, regroup and focus: architecture, dependencies, org charts

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Creates an interactive diagram in the conversation from nodes and edges you supply. Use it when the user asks to draw, diagram, map or visualize how the parts of something relate: system architecture, services and the calls between them, data models, dependency trees, workflows, organizations, knowledge maps. Not for charts of numeric data. In the diagram the user can collapse and expand boxes, regroup at each level of nesting, focus on an item and what connects to it, show clusters and cycles, and search, hide and export. The server checks the diagram and stores nothing. STRUCTURE: every node has a unique 'id'. A node with no 'parent' is drawn as a box of its own; a node WITH a 'parent' is drawn as a ROW inside its parent's box (an endpoint inside a service, a column inside a table) and the parent can be collapsed. 'group' (top-level nodes only) draws a labelled boundary around nodes, nested with '/': 'AWS/VPC' puts the node in a VPC box inside an AWS box. If you use groups, give EVERY top-level node a group: the views that draw groups as closed or stacked boxes are offered only when no node is left out. Edges run between any two nodes, rows included; give an edge a short 'label' only when the relation is not obvious ('HTTPS', 'publishes'). Optional per node: 'description' (shown on hover; add one only where the label is not enough), 'link' (an https URL, opened on double-click), 'color', 'kind': 'field' for an attribute-style row, 'collapsed': true to start folded. Optional per edge: 'color', 'style' ('dashed' for async or optional, 'dotted' for weak). Keep it legible: prefer grouping and nesting over hundreds of top-level boxes; use color for a category, not decoration.

title.description: Diagram title, shown as its name.

nodes.description: The boxes and rows to draw. A node without a parent is a box; a node with a parent is a row inside that box.

id.description: Unique id; edges and parents refer to it.

label.description: Text drawn on the node. Defaults to the id.

parent.description: Id of the node this one is drawn inside, as a row.

group.description: Boundary path for a top-level node, nested with '/', e.g. 'AWS/VPC'. If any top-level node has one, give one to all of them.

color.description: Node color; use it for a category, not decoration.

edges.description: Arrows between nodes, by node id; rows can be endpoints too. May be empty.

label.description: Short text on the arrow, only when the relation is not obvious, e.g. 'HTTPS'.

color.description: Arrow color; use it for a category of relation.

style.description: 'solid' (default), 'dashed' for async or optional, 'dotted' for weak.
